verdict.rationale: smolagents is a pip-installable Python library that runs agents in your own code. It supports fully local models via transformers or ollama, and it executes code locally through LocalPythonExecutor or self-run Docker sandboxes, so the core product can be run entirely on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of fully offline or self-hosted deployment.
